mechanics.name: Anima Lash
mechanics.note: Fixture: the hit that kills the tank.

mechanics.name: Anima Surge
mechanics.note: Kickable: the Warden opens with it after a Lash. Pummel, Kick or Counterspell.

mechanics.name: Wrack Soul
mechanics.note: Magic; left up it ticks for the rest of the pull.

mechanics.name: Anima Cascade
mechanics.note: Fixture: in the Warden's kit but never cast on this pull, so the page has a mechanic nobody failed.

mechanics.name: Necrotic Wound
mechanics.note: Fixture: the Warden's tank debuff, invented for the sample encounter; it lands on whoever is holding him, and nobody can play around it.
